title: Upland grassland restoration monitoring — draft data dictionary
description: Draft variable definitions for the restoration monitoring survey. Not yet used to collect anything.

fields.name: plot_id
fields.description: Permanent identifier for the monitoring plot.

fields.name: survey_date
fields.description: Date of the plot visit, as written by field staff on paper forms.

fields.name: survey_start_time
fields.description: Local clock time at which recording began.

fields.name: survey_duration
fields.description: How long the plot visit took.

fields.name: survey_year
fields.description: Field season the visit belongs to.

fields.name: soil_horizon
fields.description: Horizon the core was taken from, identified in the field.

fields.name: restoration_treatment
fields.description: Restoration treatment applied to the plot.

fields.name: ph
fields.description: Soil pH measured in water suspension.

fields.name: organic_carbon_pct
fields.description: Soil organic carbon as a percentage of dry mass.

fields.name: sward_height_cm
fields.description: Mean sward height across the quadrat.

fields.name: waterlogged
fields.description: Whether standing water was present at the plot during the visit.

fields.name: quadrat_species_cover
fields.description: Percentage cover per species, keyed by species name.
